quarterly_data.signal: Nippon Steel's hydrogen-embrittlement-resistant 2.0 GPa-class aluminized hot-stamping steel sheet (2.0G AL-HS) has been adopted for underbody reinforcement components in Nissan Motor's all-new ELGRAND, and by an unnamed overseas automaker for upper-body reinforcement components.
